## Column1 {width = "35%"}

```{r, loadpackages}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)
library(gt)
```

```{r, getrecentobservations}

#Define ebird API key.
api_key <- Sys.getenv("api_key")

#API Call
notable_obs <- request("https://api.ebird.org/v2/data/obs/US-MI/recent/notable") |> 
  req_url_query(
    detail = "full",
  ) |> 
  req_headers(
    `X-eBirdApiToken` = api_key,
  ) |> 
  req_perform() |>
  resp_body_json()
```

```{r}
# Convert to tibble
notable_obs_df <- map_dfr(notable_obs, ~ as_tibble(.x))

```



```{r, createtable}
# Create dashboard table
notable_obs_df |>
  select(comName, obsDt, subnational2Name, locName, howMany) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Notable Bird Sightings**")) |>
  cols_label(
    comName = md("**Common Name**"),
    obsDt = md("**Date**"),
    subnational2Name = md("**County**"),
    locName = md("**Location**"),
    howMany = md("**Number Observed**")
  ) |>
  fmt_number(columns = howMany, decimals = 0) |>
  fmt_date(columns = obsDt, date_style = "yMd") |>
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md("**Source: [ebird.org](https://ebird.org) Web API**")
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(14)
  )
  
```

## Column2 {width = "65%"}

### Row {.row6}

```{r, sendtoojs}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
ojs_define(notable_obs_ojs = notable_obs_df)
```

```{ojs, createCountyDropdown}
//| expandable: false
// Transpose the data to make it usable in ojs.
notable_observations = transpose(notable_obs_ojs)

// Create a dropdown menu of the county name.
viewof countyDropdown = Inputs.select(
  notable_observations.map(d => d.subnational2Name),
  {
    label: "Choose a county",
    unique: true,
    sort: true
    }
)
```

### Row {.row4}

```{ojs, createBarChart}
//| expandable: false

// Filter to only the county selected from the dropdown.
filtered_county = notable_observations.filter(d => d.subnational2Name === countyDropdown);

// Create a horizontal bar graph using Observable Plot.
Plot.plot({
  title: "Notable Observations for " + countyDropdown + " County",
  marginLeft: 175,
  height: filtered_county.length * 5 + 100,
  x: {
    label: "Number Observed"
  },
  y: {
    label: "Species Common Name"
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(filtered_county, 
      Plot.groupY(
      {x: "sum"}, 
      {y: "comName", 
      x: "howMany",
      sort: { y: "x", reverse: true },
      fill: "#888"})),
    Plot.text(filtered_county, // Add data labels
      Plot.groupY(
      {x: "sum"}, 
      {y: "comName", 
      x: "howMany",
      text: d => d3.sum(d.map(x => x.howMany)),
      dx: -17,
      dy: 0,
      fill: "#fff",
      textAnchor: "start",
    })),
      ]
})
```
